EC1: 1. The patient is pregnant [OR] or breastfeeding.
EC2: 2. Evidence of STEMI [AND] within 72 hours of the intended treatment on infarct related [OR] or non-infarct related artery.
EC3: 3. Cardiogenic shock on presentation or during current hospitalization.
EC4: 4. Left ventricular ejection fraction less than 20%.
EC5: 5. Known allergies to: aspirin [OR], clopidogrel  (Plavix) [OR] and ticlopidine [OR] (Ticlid) [OR], heparin [OR], bivalirudin [OR], stainless steel [OR], or contrast agent (which cannot be adequately premedicated).
EC6: 6. A platelet count [OR] less than 75,000 cells/mm3 [OR] or greater than 700,000 cells/mm3  [OR] or a WBC less than 3,000 cells/mm3.
EC7: 7. Acute [OR] or chronic renal dysfunction (creatinine greater than 2.5 mg/dl [OR] or less than 150µmol/L).
EC8: 8. Subject is currently participating in an investigational drug or device study that has not completed the primary endpoint or that clinically interferes with the current study endpoints. (Note: Trials requiring extended follow-up for products that were investigational, but have since become commercially available, are not considered investigational trials).
EC10: 10. Within 30 days prior to the index study procedure, the subject has undergone a previous coronary interventional procedure of any kind. Note: This exclusion criterion does [NOT] not apply to post-STEMI patients.
EC11: 11. Stroke [OR] or transient ischemic attack within the prior 3 months.
EC12: 12. Active peptic ulcer [OR] or upper gastrointestinal bleeding within the prior 3 months.
EC14: 14. Unprotected left main coronary artery disease [AND] (stenosis greater than 50%).
EC15: 15. In the investigator's opinion, subject has a co-morbid condition(s) that could limit the life expectancy to less than one year, or limit the subject's ability to participate in the study or comply with follow-up requirements or impact the scientific integrity of the study.
EC16: 16. Subject has normal [OR] or insignificant coronaries (i.e. coronary lesion(s) less than 50% stenosis).
EC17: 17. Any target vessel has evidence of:
EC18: excessive thrombus (e.g. requires target vessel thrombectomy)
EC19: tortuousity (greater than 60 degree angle) that makes it unsuitable for proper stent delivery and deployment,
EC21: 18. Any target lesion [AND] requires treatment [AND] with a device [NOT] other than percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA) prior to stent placement (e.g. but not limited to, directional coronary atherectomy [OR], excimer laser [OR], rotational atherectomy, etc.).
EC22: 19. Any lesion that is located in a saphenous vein graft [OR], however, lesions located within the native vessel  but accessed through the graft are eligible.
EC23: 20. The target vessel is in a "last remaining" epicardial vessel (e.g. greater than 2 non-target epicardial vessels and the bypass grafts to these territories [if present] are totally occluded).
